title: Fix order placement stuck on loading when clicking Place Order

requirements.text: Identify and fix the root cause of the customer order placement flow getting stuck in a perpetual loading state when submitting the order form ("Create Order" / "Place Order"). Ensure the mutation always resolves (success or error) and the UI never remains stuck on loading indefinitely.

quotes: When clicking place order it is stuck on loading fix order placing code

acceptanceCriteria: From NewOrderPage, submitting a valid order reliably completes within a reasonable time and no longer stays stuck in the loading state.
If the backend rejects/traps (e.g., unauthorized, banned, rate-limited, duplicate ID), the frontend exits loading state and displays an English error message.
If the network/agent call hangs, the frontend times out, exits loading state, and shows an actionable English error message (e.g., "Request timed out. Please try again.").

requirements.text: Backend: Add a caller-safe ban-status API that the frontend can use without causing unresolved calls. Implement a `public query ({ caller }) func isCallerBanned() : async Bool` that returns whether `caller` is in the banned set, and enforce that only authenticated users can call it (same permission gate style used elsewhere).

quotes: When clicking place order it is stuck on loading fix order placing code

acceptanceCriteria: `isCallerBanned` exists in `backend/main.mo` and returns `true` only when the authenticated caller is banned, otherwise `false`.
Unauthenticated callers receive an Unauthorized trap consistent with other protected query methods.
Frontend can call `actor.isCallerBanned()` without agent/candid errors.

requirements.text: Frontend: Make the create-order mutation robust against hanging canister calls by wrapping the backend order-creation call in a timeout (Promise.race) and surfacing the timeout as a user-facing error, so the submit button cannot remain stuck in `createOrder.isPending`.

quotes: When clicking place order it is stuck on loading fix order placing code

acceptanceCriteria: If the backend call does not settle within the defined timeout window, the mutation rejects, `createOrder.isPending` becomes false, and the user sees a timeout error message in English.
After any failure (validation error, banned, unauthorized, rate-limited, timeout), the user can immediately click the submit button again (no stuck pending state).

requirements.text: Frontend: Improve error reporting for failed order creation so users aren’t left with only a spinner. Ensure errors from backend traps/rejects are converted into clear English messages and displayed in the existing error Alert on NewOrderPage.

quotes: When clicking place order it is stuck on loading fix order placing code

acceptanceCriteria: When the backend returns an Unauthorized error, the page shows an English message prompting the user to sign in.
When the backend indicates a security block (e.g., rate limiting / "TREY C SECURITY"), the page shows an English message explaining the request was blocked and to retry later.

When the backend indicates a duplicate order ID, the page shows an English message and the app auto-retries with a new generated order ID or instructs the user to retry (implementation choice is acceptable as long as it is not stuck).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; only add migration.mo changes if state schema changes require it.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any frontend immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Adding new payment providers or external checkout systems.
Changing the overall order form fields or introducing new product features unrelated to fixing the stuck loading/order placement reliability.
